name: Rerouted Bus
text: When this card wins a trick, you may have it count for your partner instead.
decision: Whether the team's count is better served by giving this trick to your partner: to land their exact bid, or to keep yours from going over.
opponent: Visible on trigger; the trick still goes to your team.
aiNote: Give the trick to your partner when you've already taken your bid and they haven't taken theirs; never give it to a nil partner.
rationale: Moving one trick between partners lands exact-count payoffs (True Aim, Honest Ruler, Balanced Yin-Yang, Attentive Ear) and Runner-Up Trophy's split without changing anyone's bid. It is a risk-free nudge, but only on the trick this card wins.
deviation: Redesigned from raising your partner's bid, because sigils change only their owner's bid.
